answer: The handbook states that the monthly minimum wage for a full-time job of at most 182 hours per month is 6,443.85 NIS, and that the minimum wage per hour of work is 35.4 NIS.
informationLabel: This summary is provided for general informational purposes only, and is not a substitute for the wording of the relevant laws, regulations, procedures and extension orders, which are binding.

claims.quote: the monthly minimum wage of an employee working in a full-time job (a maximum of 182 hours per month) is 6,443.85 NIS. The minimum wage per hour of work is NIS 35.4
